flat.estimand: Within each game, mean difference over eligible voyages for the originally first/last window participant; then equally weight games. This is the effect of reversing the entire window.

ladder.estimand: Within each game, mean difference over eligible voyages for the originally first/last window participant; then equally weight games. This is the effect of reversing the entire window.

pricing_comparison.order_balance_metric: 0.5 * [(reverse-normal for original first) - (reverse-normal for original last)]; average eligible voyages inside each game, then games
